Historical replay runs independent segments; never aggregate capital, returns, equity or risk across resets.
No financial deltas, profitability ranking, execution forecast or trading authority are created by this contract.
Metrics are existing backend PAPER outputs, not a matched experimental performance comparison.
Displayed scenario and historical segment values must never be subtracted, ranked, annualized or pooled.
Historical receipt gaps reset capital, risk, orders and inventory; no multi-segment PnL or return is defined.
Simulation frame count is not wall-clock duration, trading volume or proof of equivalent source coverage.
Capital utilization is sourced only from the PAPER Vault, not inferred from inventory exposure.
A missing backend value remains unavailable, never imputed as zero.
Source labels and scenario service receipts do not prove exchange authenticity, licensed history or real fills.
Recorded-source and permitted-use labels are user assertions, not verified license or exchange authentication.
Receipt coverage and explicit gaps never establish continuous historical market delivery.
Order-book snapshots do not prove queue position, intermediate trades or actual passive fills.
Perpetual-context event time is unknown; no synthetic external provider history is implied.
Research evidence has no order, capital, reference-consensus or strategy authority.
